title: Building an AI-powered sales machine with Claude #ai #b2b #claude
description:
Stop guessing your ideal customer profile with manual research methods.

See how to build an AI-powered prospecting workflow using Claude agents to analyze your market, score prospects, and push high-quality leads directly to your CRM. This automated approach saves hours of manual searching by identifying the best-fit companies for your business model.

Subscribe for more practical AI sales workflows and leave a comment on what you want to automate next.
